name: Guava
imageAlt: fresh ripe organic pink guava sliced in half
description: Guava is an elite tropical botanical fruit renowned for its industry-leading Vitamin C concentration and metabolic optimization potential. With a disciplined glycemic footprint, it delivers high soluble fiber and active carotenoids engineered to support immune defense, endothelial vascular tone, and insulin sensitivity.
macroIntro: A water-dense architecture featuring complex structural carbohydrates and a high dietary fiber baseline.
microIntro: A highly bioavailable matrix providing astronomical levels of Vitamin C alongside essential carotenoids and minerals.

healthBenefits: Immune Amplification: High Vitamin C promotes leukocyte activity and neutralizes free radicals.
Glycemic Control: Soluble pectin slows carbohydrate breakdown, keeping glucose levels steady.
GI Motility: High fiber content prevents transit stasis and supports mucosal health.
Cardiovascular Support: Potassium and polyphenols improve arterial elasticity.
Cellular Shielding: Lycopene and beta-carotene prevent lipid peroxidation.
precautionsIntro: Nutritional considerations regarding digestive and renal health:
precautions: Fiber Loading: Sudden high intake may cause bloating; increase volume gradually.
Oxalate Concentration: Moderate oxalates require portion management in those prone to kidney stones.
Mechanical Irritation: Hard central seeds may irritate intestinal walls in sensitive individuals or those with diverticulitis.
